sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Infernal Rouge (炼狱红妆) is a one-handed blade in Phantom Blade Zero's primary weapon set. The first Tempering endpoint: Sanguine at level 5 becomes this and grants Bloodline Rebirth.

sections.title: Weapon Class and Slot
sections.content: Infernal Rouge (炼狱红妆) occupies the Primary slot, and it is classed as One-handed. Soul carries two primary blades and two secondary Phantom Edges at once, and switching between the four refills stamina rather than costing it - which is what keeps a combo chain running. Sha-chi is a separate pool, spent on heavy attacks and blocks. The full class lists are on the blade index.

sections.title: Stats and Effects
sections.content: Infernal Rouge (炼狱红妆) has no published damage, scaling or speed figure, because the game does not print a numeric stat sheet for individual weapons. Nothing has been measured for this one either, so those three numbers are absent rather than estimated - the slot and the property are what the choice actually turns on.

sections.title: How It Plays
sections.content: Nothing verified has been published on how Infernal Rouge (炼狱红妆) behaves inside a combo, so no chain is described here. The general rule still applies: swapping to a secondary refills stamina instead of spending it, so the second slot is what extends a chain past the point the blade you were using runs dry - see the combat system.

sections.title: How to Obtain
sections.content:
Temper Sanguine at level 5 (grants Bloodline Rebirth).

Acquisition points are taken from the acquisition table on the weapons hub, which is kept in step with this page - if a route is corrected there, it is corrected here.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This page records Infernal Rouge (炼狱红妆) by slot, class and acquisition point, and by its property where one is published. Figures the game itself does not expose are left out. The system as a whole, with the full slot and class breakdown, is on the weapons list.
